description: 一次同步创建 1 到 100 条短链。按 client_ref 对应结果，允许部分成功。需要已注册账户。批量重试只有三种情况，不要混用。示例：key 为 batch-1，两项 client_ref 分别为 notes（https://example.com/notes）和 draft（https://example.com/draft）。notes 成功，draft 的 retryable 为 true。(1) 传输结果不确定（没有拿到已完成的响应、IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS、幂等锁不可用，或因瞬时数据库错误且一条都未创建而返回 503）：用同一个 key 原样重发整批。已完成的批次返回已保存的结果，notes 不会再次创建。key 已被释放时，同一批会重新执行。(2) 已完成且某项 retryable 为 true：重放 batch-1 只返回已保存的结果，不会重试 draft。只用新 key（例如 batch-1-draft）发送 draft，并保留 client_ref draft，不要带上 notes。去掉 notes 后仍用 batch-1 会返回 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT。(3) 校验错误：改正请求，不要把同一份无效请求当作网络重试。key 尚未保存的 400（重复 client_ref、缺少 items、BATCH_TOO_LARGE）改正后可以继续用同一个 key。已完成且 retryable 为 false 的项已保存；改正文后用原 key 会返回 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT，改正后的项必须用新 key。 Create 1 to 100 short links in one synchronous request. Match each result by client_ref. Partial success is allowed. A registered account is required. Batch retry has three cases; do not mix them. Worked example: key batch-1 with client_ref notes (https://example.com/notes) and draft (https://example.com/draft). notes succeeds and draft is retryable true. (1) Uncertain transport outcome — no completed body, IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, an unavailable idempotency lock, or 503 because a transient database error created nothing: resend the entire unchanged batch with the same key. A completed batch returns the stored result and notes is not created again. A released key runs that same batch again. (2) Completed batch with retryable true: replaying batch-1 returns the stored body and does not retry draft. Send only draft, keeping client_ref draft, under a new key such as batch-1-draft. Do not include notes. Dropping notes and reusing batch-1 returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. (3) Validation error: fix the request. Do not resend the same invalid body as a network retry. A 400 before the key is stored (duplicate client_ref, missing items, BATCH_TOO_LARGE) may reuse the key after the body is corrected. A completed item with retryable false is stored; a changed body on that key returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, so send the corrected item with a new key.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key for this create. Required. Replays within 24h.

items.description: Synchronous batch items (1 to 100). Each item creates one short link.

alias.description: Optional custom path segment (stored lowercase). Do not send customSlug.

client_ref.description: Batch item correlation id (never use array index).

locale.description: API language preference. Canonical values: en and zh-CN. Documented aliases normalized to the canonical value: zh-cn, zh-Hans, zh-hans, zh_Hans, zh_hans. Traditional Chinese is not supported. EN, ZH-CN, and bare zh are rejected. Omitted or blank defaults to en. This preference does not rewrite URL bytes, translate parameter names, or use the caller's location. Website routes stay /zh-cn.

title.description: Optional link title, at most 256 characters.

url.description: Destination HTTPS/HTTP URL to shorten. Required. Do not send longUrl.

name: shorten_urls

resend_path.description: Where to resend the verification email when verification would raise this account's limits.

title: Batch shorten · 批量短链（短.在线）
